connector.name: Identity Forge
connector.registryDescription: Design kits, brand naming, and domain research for coding agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package identityforge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.identityforge, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IDENTITYFORGE_API_KEY
env.description: Identity Forge API key (ifk_…). Optional for browsing free kits; required for Pro kits, naming boards, and writes. Run `npx --yes identityforge@latest login`; for a new email-password account, complete browser signup, select Send verification email, open its link, and approve the resumed authorization. A confirmed account enables persistent projects, saved work, and authenticated quota.
